questions.question_text: Which of these definite integrals is **undefined**?

options.why: $3x-12$ is never zero between $5$ and $9$, so this integral does exist.
The whole interval lies below $x=4$, and a negative limit alone does not make an integral undefined.
The denominator is negative but never zero here, and the modulus handles negative values.

questions.solution_text:
$3x-12 = 0$ when $x = 4$.
$x = 4$ lies between the limits $1$ and $6$, so $\dfrac{1}{3x-12}$ is undefined inside that interval.
$\int_{1}^{6} \dfrac{1}{3x-12}\,dx$ is undefined.
